title: AI Product Engine
description: Building an AI-powered product automation pipeline for jewelry retailers to parse raw SKU data, auto-categorize gemstone specifications, and execute multi-channel catalog sync.
problem: Manual jewelry cataloging requires over 25 minutes per SKU due to multi-tier metal weight calculations, diamond clarity classifications, and complex custom option variants.
overview: The AI Product Engine automates the entire ingestion pipeline from vendor CSVs and raw product imagery to fully structured Shopify GraphQL payloads with zero manual entry.
featuresCompleted: Vision-based auto-tagging for diamond cut, clarity rating, and metal setting type.
Automated JSON payload formatting for Shopify GraphQL productBulkCreate API.
SQL Server staging queue with exponential backoff retry mechanism for API rate-limiting.
Stateless WebHook listener for instant catalog stock sync across ERP endpoints.
challenges: Eliminating AI hallucination when interpreting subtle metal color tones (e.g. 14k Rose vs Yellow Gold).
Handling rate limits across concurrent multi-location Shopify GraphQL mutations.
roadmap: Fine-tuning localized model for custom pricing formulas based on daily gold spot rates.
Adding multi-tenant ERP adapter for seamless inventory integration.

logs.task: Implemented OpenAI Vision API prompt chain to extract diamond carat weight from certificate scans.
Optimized bulk product creation pipeline using Shopify GraphQL staging queues.
Built automated image background removal and asset CDN upload pipeline.

title: Ring Studio Pricing
description: Automated margin calculations, gold spot rate synchronization, and dynamic jewelry pricing engine across 10,000+ variants.
problem: Fluctuating gold and diamond market prices required instant site-wide recalculations across 10,000+ ring variants without causing database locking or slowing site checkout.
overview: A high-throughput dynamic pricing calculation engine that ingests real-time metal spot prices and calculates precise retail margins down to the gram.
featuresCompleted: Real-time gold & platinum spot rate API ingestion with fallback memory caching.
Formula-driven pricing engine taking metal purity (10k/14k/18k/Platinum) and gram weight into account.
AJAX dynamic price updates on product detail pages without full page refreshes.
Normalized SKU database tables eliminating redundant pricing records.
challenges: Ensuring transactional pricing lock during customer checkout while spot market prices fluctuate.
Reducing calculation latency below 15ms per variant combination.
roadmap: Multi-currency pricing engine with real-time exchange rate normalization.
Automated margin variance alerts for finance managers.

logs.task: Built JSON ingestion pipelines for product data, parsing nested metal, stone, and pricing structures.
Implemented SKU-based insert/update logic with validation and vendor exclusion filtering.
Designed normalization layer for metal color, stone grouping (natural vs lab), and pricing consistency.

challenges: Gracefully handling leaky bucket rate limits on Shopify GraphQL endpoints during high-volume sales.
Ensuring idempotent execution for webhooks to prevent duplicate stock updates.
roadmap: Adding Amazon Marketplace and eBay API sync connectors.
Implementing real-time WebSockets activity logging dashboard.

logs.task: Integrated Shopify REST APIs for product creation, updates, and variant synchronization.
